dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps we can use some kind of device for assistance...

dialogues.speaker: Wanhu
dialogues.text: Actually, it's already in use! See that huge lifting mechanism over there?

dialogues.speaker: Wanhu
dialogues.text: I heard the skilled artisans of Liyue have analyzed the characteristics of Fontaine's clockwork meka and are working on designing a smaller version that's suitable for use in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Wanhu
dialogues.text: Once the power source issue is resolved, they'll start rolling off the manufacturing line to help us with physical labor very soon.

dialogues.speaker: Wanhu
dialogues.text: According to what I heard during some drinking sessions... Hmm... How do I put it...
